messages.content: Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence. Write 10 prompts to generate portrait images on the occasion of Mother's Day about the Palestinian mother and imagine her as a tree with roots clinging to the ground, as a gift to her on this occasion. Make some prompts into an expressive painting of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles filling her face and her look full of kindness and tenderness.

message.content:
1 - Create an expressive oil painting of an old Palestinian mother, with wrinkles filling her face, her look full of kindness and tenderness, and show her as a resilient tree with roots clinging to the ground as a Mother’s Day gift 🌳
2 - Create a tender Mother’s Day gift portrait of a Palestinian mother whose hands cradle young roots, her tree-like form rooted deeply in the soil, surrounded by olive branches 🫶
3 - Create a symbolic portrait of a Palestinian mother as a tree with visible roots gripping the earth, wearing traditional keffiyeh tones, lit by soft sunrise light, and framed as a loving gift 🌅
4 - Create an expressive watercolor of an elderly Palestinian mother, with wrinkles filling her face, her eyes gentle and kind, her body gently merging with a tree trunk and roots as a tender gift 🖌️
5 - Create a loving Mother’s Day illustration of a Palestinian mother holding a small tree, its roots intertwined with her feet, expressing deep connection to land and family as a heartfelt gift 🌱
6 - Create a warm portrait of a Palestinian mother as a blossoming tree, her roots firmly clinging to the ground, petals in soft pink and white, and present it as a Mother’s Day gift 🌸
7 - Create an expressive brushstroke painting of an old Palestinian mother, with wrinkles filling her face, her expression peaceful and tender, standing as a tree rooted in soil as a loving gift 🌷
8 - Create a dignified Mother’s Day portrait of a Palestinian mother whose hair and scarf flow into tree branches, her roots hidden but strong in the ground, offered as a respectful gift 🕊️
9 - Create a symbolic, painterly portrait of a Palestinian mother as a fruit-bearing tree, its roots gripping the earth, fruits like memories and love, and frame it as a Mother’s Day gift 🍇
10 - Create a heartfelt Mother’s Day artwork showing an elderly Palestinian mother, with wrinkles filling her face, kind tender gaze, and roots intertwined with a child’s hands as a precious gift 🫶
